sources.title: ASSIST-QuickSearch Basic Search
sources.snippet: Enter search criteria in one or more of three text fields: Document ID, Document Number, Find Term (s). Filter search results by selecting Status or FSC/Area from drop-down lists, or by checking the box and specifying a range of document dates. Click a label for a detailed description and sample search results.
